Anker just released their Solix E10 indoor/outdoor, weatherproof 10,000 watt capable 120v/240v hybrid power system, along with a new tri-fuel Smart Generator. I get a first look at the system & generator and share my review and tests.

Order Anker Solix E10 & More Info Here: https://ankerfast.club/E10SilverCymbal

⚡ Power & Output

Rated Voltage: 120/240 VAC (Split Phase)
Frequency: 60 Hz
Maximum Continuous Output: ~7,680 W (7.68 kW) per unit with battery
Turbo Backup Output: Up to ~10,000 W (10 kW) for ~90 min
Surge Capability: Up to ~37.2 kW with multiple batteries and units combined

🔋 Battery & Capacity
Battery Type: Li-ion (LFP)
Battery Capacity per Module: ~6,144 Wh (6.14 kWh)

Scalable Capacity:
• ~30 kWh per power module (max)
• ~60 kWh with two power modules
• ~90 kWh with three power modules
Estimated Backup Duration: Up to ~15 days with full expansion (varies with usage)

☀️ Inputs (Charging & Solar)
AC Charging Input: Up to ~7,680 W (via grid)

Solar Input:
• Up to ~9 kW per unit
• Up to ~27 kW with three units combined

Generator DC Input: ~4,500 W (for smart generator integration)
📦 Physical & Environmental

Enclosure Rating: NEMA Type 4 (weatherproof, outdoor-ready)
Operating Temp Range: -4 °F to 131 °F (-20 °C to 55 °C)
Inverter Dimensions: ~26.4" × 11.8" × 10.2" (W×H×D)
Inverter Weight: ~60.6 lbs (27.5 kg)
Battery Dimensions: ~26.4" × 12.7" × 11.1"
Battery Weight: ~130 lbs (59 kg)

🔌 Installation & Connectivity
Mounting: Floor or wall mount options
Connectivity: Wi-Fi & Bluetooth for monitoring/control
